content.title: Sanmina’s (NASDAQ:SANM) Q4 CY2025 Sales Beat Estimates But Stock Drops
content.summary: Electronics manufacturing services company Sanmina (NASDAQ:SANM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 59% year on year to $3.19 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $3.25 billion was less impressive, coming in 7.6% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.38 per share was 11% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
